label: Hetta Cole's first greeting — the work talks

purpose.value: Hetta serves the hero curtly and lets the work do the talking: the 'dark shards' he snaps under boot are craftsmanship she has re-set for Joren Pell and quietly admires.

emotionalProgression.note: She talks about as much as the anvil does; the repair quote is short and fair.
She names the maker's technique on a broken hinge charm — better than hers, some years — and says nothing plainer.
He hears a craftsman's compliment to his trophy collection; she goes back to the forge having said everything she knows how to say.

notes: Grounded bewilderment, smith register: her main flaw is that she says everything through the work and the hero has never once understood her — the scene should dramatize exactly that. She knows the shards are domestic magic (hintable via technique-talk, not lecture). She does NOT know the book's genre — no book reference. Never validate the hero's prophecy framing: there is no canon fact supporting 'the realms are evil', and that absence is itself the guard.
